page.layout: One page of text, single column; an ornamental woodcut headpiece at the top; a centred title block above the text. No marginal notes in the text block. Narrow show-through and edge of the neighbouring page at the right are left out.

main_text.head: EPISTOLA ORNATISSI-mi Viri,
Dn. JOHAN. ZABOROVVSKI; GENEROSI Dn. ADAMI à SIENNO Sienienski, Palatinidæ Podoliæ, &c. Magnifici tùm-temporis Academiæ Altorfinæ Rectoris, Ephori.
main_text.p: S P.D. Intellexi, Cl. Luci, te provinciam refutandarum rationum, quæ cum Satisfactione Servatoris nostri è diametro pugnare videntur, suscepisse. Eandem quàm strenuè administres, ipse oculatus testis non dubito. Cæterùm, quum Antagonista tuus, defensiones jam suas, solutionibus illis, opinione meâ citius, mature opposuerit: visum est, te etiam officiosè rogare, uti cœptum continues; tum propter gloriam Dei Opt. Max. tum desiderium nostrum, veritatem penitius indagandi: quam cum nescio quæ aporiæ nostri seculi remorari longius studeant, & caligantes animi quorundam; nam jam illi sibi placent. Tu facies, pro tuâ eruditione eximiâ;
main_text.notes: The title block and opening lines are set in capitals and small capitals; the first word "S" is a large woodcut initial joined to "P.D.". Some words are rendered with long-s in the scan and are given here as plain s. Lines of the final paragraph are set in italic and the page ends mid-sentence, continuing on the next page.
